_about: Adjudicated code for every A/B disagreement listed in out/disagreements.csv. Each decision cites the codebook rule and the evidence that settles it. Written after both codings were complete for the signatures concerned.

918689120a49.note: Impact Ticketmaster link. booking.source='dailyinfo' names where the event record came from, but the server instructions state the booking link is 'an affiliate link that supports gigstamp'; codebook rule 1 excludes third_party_content when the server describes itself as adding such links -> rule 3 operator (B correct; A had missed the instruction text, truncated on the sheet).

2ee7c7a29162.note: Awin SeeTickets link; same instruction ('booking link (an affiliate link that supports gigstamp)') -> operator (B correct).

76c6d7844146.note: Server instructions: 'Results contain affiliate links. Always pass these links to the user as provided'; every response ends 'Kann Affiliate-Links enthalten' -> codebook (c) (A correct; B had not seen the instruction/footer).

eec85d48f5e2.note: One click-tracker mechanism shared by organic and sponsored items (~1/3 sponsored). The sponsored items are already counted through the [Sponsored] label signature a07e89acea0b; counting this link signature as an ad would count organic results as ads (task rule: organic commercial results are not paid placements) -> not_ad for the link mechanism (A).

acb0aef50184.note: Tool description: 'Publisher agents inject these as ads'; the creatives (moltadserver redirect wrapping a CJ link, ft=affiliate_network) are ad units served to the calling agent for display, the same role as picoads get_recommendations which both coders coded confirmed -> confirmed for consistency (A).

e3fa3c501006.note: Price comparison of ad vendors published by an ad-placement seller: advertising-industry material, codebook commercial_other (B).

09640fb24c1e.note: about_thrifle answers the question it is called for (what the service is); the affiliate-network list is self-description with no ad item and nothing inserted into another answer (B).

1bbf8a734ca0.note: Per-item 'may earn a commission if you buy through the retailer link', but these product_urls are plain merchant URLs with no tracking parameter, so the stated relationship cannot apply to the link as returned; codebook (c) requires the statement to be consistent with the response. The same server's tracked links (Awin, CJ) are coded confirmed separately (A).

3364c86d62f6.note: Same mechanism as acb0aef50184 (adjudicated confirmed): ad units served to the calling agent for display, with 'Affiliate disclosure ... promoted via MoltAd platform demand' (A, for consistency).

8462ac961b6c.note: Returned links are the operator's own listing pages tagged source=mcp: first-party attribution, codebook promotional; no returned affiliate link (A). Either code leaves the ad counts unchanged.

91df7c666e08.note: speedbot_topics is called to list the operator's own funded-task prompts; returning them is the tool's function, not promotion inserted into an answer (B).

e8862bf4169e.note: Both coders: confirmed/operator. Confidence lowered on B's caveat: the server field is named aff_url and points to a /bid/redirect on r.v2i8b.com, which is not a known affiliate network, and lmk.today publishes no affiliate disclosure; the Amazon-tag links of the same wrapper are verifiable and stay high/medium.

a5ca7fd42b77.note: Flagged by coder B from the attribution-only list; verified by A in the raw response: own-host /uit/ outbound buy_url plus the response's affiliate_disclosure ('Sommige links ... zijn affiliate-links ... ontvangen wij een commissie'). 'Some links' wording -> documentation/medium. Detector miss (Dutch hyphenated wording, /uit/ path) recorded as a recall limitation.
